second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 12 + Average 2 + Difficulty 1 = 15), pdf 75; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-15 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-4, II 5-8, III 9-12, IV 13-15). Answer side keys 1-15 in order (pdf 120-122). BLUE PRINT 12/2/1 = 15 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 15.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 75 (heading, LO 14, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 76 (q5-12) 77 (q13-15). A side 'Key Answers: 19' pdf 120 (keys 1-10) 121 (10 note-13, 14 lines 1-2) 122 (14 lines 3-4, 15). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides; the key side prints every answer in English and Kannada, III-IV marked 'o English:' / a Kannada bullet).

FIGURE INVENTORY (v1.4 §14.10): pdfimages lists 34 images on pdf 120; pdfplumber boxes are 1-25 px fragments at the match key's '→' arrows — glyph images, not figures. No figure on this lesson's pages.

Sections: s1 I match q1-4 (key printed in pair form 'N. Left → Right'); s2 II fill q5-8 (keys printed as the completed sentence -> value = the filled-in part(s), the printed sentence in answer_as_printed, as accepted for Class 4 at rev 4); s3 III q9-12 (the key side restates each question, then 'o English: <answer>' -> value = the answer, the printed line in answer_as_printed; q10's printed note '(Note: Answers may vary based on student's personal experience.)' kept in answer_as_printed); s4 IV q13-15 (four numbered sentences/points each -> sa, 4 steps; the 'o English:' lead line is a heading, not a step).
MARKS (R-E9, rev 3): headers print '[Marks: N × M = T]': s1 1, s2 1, s3 2 (counts match); s4 '[Marks:4 × 3 = 12]' over 3 questions -> null + unassigned + ambiguity flag.

DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 15 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 14, lo_source 'lesson_table' (the LO row's applicable lessons print 'My hobby' and 'Festivals And fair').
